purpose: Find the operands, worked examples and recorded review observations for each named business calculation or ordered layer procedure. Locations are JSON Pointers in the named catalog; observation pointers are in ../traceability/mathematics-verification.json.
earlier_review: The earlier summary reported 142 contracts and 180 checks. The detailed receipt identifies 180 observations, including journal and rounding checks and rows named in ordinary language. A receipt pointer identifies a related check. An empty list means that no named observation in that receipt was attributed to this rule. Overlapping observations do not count as distinct definitions.
scope: The calculation catalogs contain 184 named definitions plus FIFO and LIFO. Worked cases are document fixtures. The additional comparison count applies to the reviewed case, not to all inputs or service execution. Conditional capability examples retain the applicability stated by their definitions.
